description: Machine-readable evidence contracts for the bounded IFC egress-door/building-information task.
pending_semantics: Evidence not resolved on an admitted path remains pending and emits the source request; it is not converted to a legal or engineering verdict.

value_layer.length_unit: project length unit normalized to metres
value_layer.accepted_fire_tokens: non-empty token in the declared fire-rating vocabulary

rules.pending_when: no admitted width path or unreadable unit/value
rules.engineering_action: request the width source and preserve the door identifier

rules.pending_when: the admitted opening/host chain is unavailable
rules.engineering_action: request the host relation or re-export the opening context

rules.pending_when: the shared building source is unavailable or unreadable
rules.engineering_action: request one shared building source before triaging dependent rows

rules.pending_when: the property/type source is unavailable or the token cannot be read
rules.engineering_action: request the property source; do not convert an unreadable token to failure
